instruction: Please disable Chrome's preloading feature to prevent it from loading pages before I click on links.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling page preloading in Chrome privacy settings. Custom getter get_chrome_disable_preload__7df16cad checks Chrome Preferences for network_prediction_options setting (0=disabled, 1=WiFi only, 2=always). Returns 'true' when set to disabled (0).
metadata.verification: Custom getter verifies network_prediction_options is set to 0 (disabled) in Chrome Preferences net or profile section.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads Chrome Preferences file for network_prediction_options setting
Checks both 'net.network_prediction_options' and 'profile.network_prediction_options' sections (handles multiple Chrome versions)
Returns 'true' when preloading is disabled (value=0), 'false' when enabled, semantically correct
Metric uses exact_match to compare result='true' with expected='true', logically sound
Expected value 'true' correctly represents disabled state as required by instruction
Postconfig restarts Chrome to ensure fresh profile state is read
Complete coverage: evaluator fully verifies the instruction requirement (disable preloading)
Platform-specific paths handled correctly for Windows/Darwin/Linux
